'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]].

Getting here the first time requires {{SCP|Sailing|61|link=yes}}. At {{SCP|Construction|50|link=yes}} you can build a rowboat to the [[Isle of Souls]], requiring 8 [[camphor plank|camphor planks]], 10 [[swamp paste]] and a [[hammer]] and [[saw]] to build.
